featured_reviews.name: anjali joshi
featured_reviews.review_text:
I highly recommend Health Bag Meal tiffin service! I ordered their tiffins for a month during a time when my husband and I were down with chicken gunya, and our cook was on long leave. Health Bag Meal truly was a lifesaver.

The food is hygienic, non-spicy, and absolutely delicious. Everything is delivered right to your doorstep in sealed bags, so there’s no spilling, mixing, or misplacement. The containers are microwave-safe, making it very convenient to reheat.

What impressed me most is the variety in the menu — no dish was repeated over the entire month! They also don’t use baking powder or baking soda, and we had zero digestion issues. The variety of vegetables and dals was particularly commendable.

Mr. Harish Sharma, the owner, is very courteous, always responds promptly and addresses the queries satisfactorily. On request, he provided vegetables without onion and garlic for my parents, and they loved them. On one occasion, there was a small mix-up in the order, but he promptly sent the correct vegetables again at no extra charge — a truly heartwarming gesture.

Overall, Health Bag Meal combines user-friendly, hygiene, and delicious home-style food with excellent customer service. I’ve already recommended them to many and I will continue to do so!

Hi, thank you for your detailed feedback. While we respect your opinion, we would like to clarify several important points to present a complete and accurate picture.

On food freshness — all our meals are prepared fresh with a defined consumption window. This was clearly discussed with you, as lunch was often being consumed quite late (around 3:30 PM), followed by dinner even later (post 10:30–11 PM). When meals are consumed significantly beyond the recommended timeframe, the taste and overall quality can naturally be affected.

On packaging and spillage — we take even a single incident seriously and addressed your concerns each time. However, we observed that the same image of one damaged container has been repeated multiple times, along with a few other instances. On service and coordination — throughout your subscription, several small concerns were raised, and we consistently spent time on calls and coordination to address each one. We made continuous efforts from our end to improve your overall experience.

On portion size and paneer quantity — our paneer dishes are priced at ₹50 per serving, within which we maintain a fixed portion size (typically 3–4 pieces). This is aligned with our pricing model. For higher quantity expectations, we had clearly suggested ordering an additional portion.

On portion measurement — our website clearly states portion sizes in terms of container volume (ml), not exact weight, as different dishes vary in density. Despite this, concerns were raised from day one by weighing individual items, which does not reflect how such meals are standardized.

On food quality concerns — whenever feedback was raised (including rajma), it was immediately escalated to our kitchen team. At the same time, we monitor feedback from other customers who received the same meals, and such issues were not widely reported. Nevertheless, we still acted on your feedback.

Regarding the comparison made about food quality — we understand that taste is subjective. However, statements comparing our food in that manner are personal opinions and do not represent the experience of our wider customer base.

We would also like to highlight that despite these concerns, multiple meals were ordered over time, and we remained consistently engaged, making continuous efforts to address feedback and improve your experience.

That said, we acknowledge that we could not meet your expectations, and we regret that. We remain committed to improving our service and maintaining transparency with all our customers.
